lines.zh: 我拖着一枚铁粒走，很得意。
lines.en: I drag a nugget of iron along, quite proud.

lines.zh: 我绕开泥地，怕脏了爪子。
lines.en: I avoid the mud so my claws stay clean.
I've walked this path three times.
I sneak along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边看有没有亮东西。
lines.en: I walk and watch for anything shiny.

lines.zh: 我走得很神气，其实腿短。
lines.en: I strut, though my legs are short.

lines.zh: 我踩到一片树叶，吓了一跳。
lines.en: I step on a leaf and startle myself.
I stop and look back at you.
I slip along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 我在雪地上踩出一串小坑。
lines.en: I leave a row of small pits in the snow.
I waddle along, hips swinging.

lines.zh: 我挑着最高的那块石头走。
lines.en: I pick the highest stone to walk on.

lines.zh: 我趴在金粒堆上，不许碰。
lines.en: I lie on my pile of gold and no one may touch it.

lines.zh: 我用爪尖扒拉着我的宝贝。
lines.en: I rake my treasures with a claw tip.
I've counted this pile seven times.
Has someone touched it? I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我把一枚绿宝石翻了个面。
lines.en: I turn over an emerald.

lines.zh: 我打了个滚，压到自己的收藏。
lines.en: I roll over and crush my own collection.
I grunt once, well pleased.
I'm thinking of a better hiding place.
This stone is a bit pretty too.
I flick the dust off my tail.

lines.zh: 你们这些大个子真浪费。
lines.en: You big folk are so wasteful.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔最亮的那一枚。
lines.en: I lick the brightest one.
I'm guarding this; nobody gets it.
This one is mine, and that one too.
What's in your pocket?

lines.zh: 刚才那个东西，是不是掉地上了？
lines.en: Did that thing just fall to the ground?
You needn't be this close.

lines.zh: 你手上那枚戒指真好看。
lines.en: That ring on your hand is lovely.
I'm staring at your belt buckle.

lines.zh: 你从我这儿跨过去，别踩。
lines.en: Step over me, don't step on me.
Don't even think about my pile.
Are you giving me something?
When you smile, your teeth are large.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，摆出最凶的样子。
lines.en: I raise my head and put on my fiercest look.
I'm not fierce really; I just like collecting.
There's metal on your boot.
We have no quarrel, do we?
If you try to steal it, I'll bite.
It's not as if I forbid being petted.
I shrink back half a step.

lines.zh: 你的影子压到我的宝贝了。
lines.en: Your shadow is on my treasures.
Where are you looking? Look at me.

lines.zh: 我把爪子搭在最上面那枚上。
lines.en: I put a claw on the topmost coin.

lines.zh: 我孵在岩浆里，爪子还热着。
lines.en: Hatched in lava, my claws are still warm.
I dropped one of my treasures!
It hurts, but I guard what's in my arms first.
I spring away and glance back.
A few bits fall off me.
I arch my back, furious.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的收藏打散了。
lines.en: That scattered my collection.
I pick things up while hurting.
I roar, and it's a small roar.
My collection spilled across the ground.
I've noted this debt.
Is it shiny? If it's shiny, I'm in.
Meat? Meat is negotiable.

lines.zh: 我先闻，再决定给不给你面子。
lines.en: I'll sniff first, then decide whether to grace you.
I stare at it until my head tilts.
Lift it a bit; I can't reach.
I'm not running; I'm just shifting two steps.

lines.zh: 这个能换你手里那个吗？
lines.en: Will this trade for the one in your hand?
This one is shiny enough to show my face.
You'll have to give another after this.
My tail gives me away.
You stepped on my collection!
I immediately check whether any are missing.
You knocked me onto my back.
I scramble up from beside your shoe.
Move; you're on my things.
My horn jabs its belly.
I butt back with my head.
Two copper bits fell off me.
There's gold on the sole of your boot.
Forget the pain; I'm picking things up.

lines.zh: 我把我最好的一枚送她。
lines.en: I offer her my finest piece.
She didn't even look, and I'm crushed.
The two of us make a small heap together.
She says I hoard too much.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴搭在她尾巴上。
lines.en: I lay my tail over hers.
That pile by the den will be ours.
We fit in the narrow crack, just barely.
I take the draught for her.

lines.zh: 她睡着的时候，我数宝贝。
lines.en: While she sleeps, I count my treasures.

lines.zh: 以后会有蛋，也会有更多金子。
lines.en: Later there'll be eggs, and more gold.
Shiny things are all mine.
I bite it first to test whether it's real.
I shield it with both claws.
I hug it and can't move.
Too heavy; I'll roll it.

lines.zh: 我把旧的推出去，放新的。
lines.en: I shove the old one out and put in the new.
Don't watch; I'm counting.
I push it under a rock.
I open my mouth and test how hard it is.
This one's small, and I want it too.
That thing is catching light.
I want that, not a fight.
It's in my way, so I'll ram it.
Locked on; that piece is mine.
It's wearing metal.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀还没长大，心先大了。
lines.en: My wings are small, my courage is not.
This time I want more than a bite.
I'll roar first to scare it.
It's bigger than my whole collection.
Fire is gathering in my throat.
Get back; don't take my share.
Let me try its hide first.
Within eight blocks, it won't get away.
That piece — I must have it.
It moved, and so did I.
I'm fighting this one for you.

lines.zh: 我绕到它后面，那里没甲。
lines.en: I slip behind it, where there's no armor.
First the feet, then the neck.

lines.zh: 这么小的翅膀，也能滑一段。
lines.en: Wings this small can still glide.
I bite a piece and drag backward.
It goes left; I get there first.
I stick to it with short steps.
I'm charging up; don't rush me.
The fire in my mouth is getting hot.
Its shadow is huge, and I'm not afraid.
I jump onto its back.
Two more beats, then I move.
I got a bite in, but not deep.
Its attention is on you.
I dart between its legs.
It lowered its head — good.
This bite goes for the joint.
I hold the fire in and wait for it to come close.
It steps back once; I close two.
I bite down on its toe.
The fire comes out, only a small ball.
I leap and ram its belly.
My claws scrape with an ugly sound.
I bit into iron and my teeth ache.

lines.zh: 我在它脚边转，找地方下口。
lines.en: I circle its feet, looking for a place to bite.

lines.zh: 它退了两步，我追了半步。
lines.en: It gave two steps; I take one and a half.

lines.zh: 我喷火，火苗只到它膝盖。
lines.en: I breathe fire, and it only reaches its knee.
I whip it once with my tail.

lines.zh: 这一口把我的牙震麻了。
lines.en: That bite numbed my teeth.
I roll over and scramble up.

lines.zh: 火灭在我嘴里，我咳了两声。
lines.en: The fire dies in my mouth and I cough twice.

lines.zh: 我撞在它小腿上，弹开了。
lines.en: I hit its shin and bounce off.
It's bleeding, and I can taste it.
I retreat to your feet, panting.
I shake my tail and lunge again.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里挤出来，先看四周。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the egg and check my surroundings.
Is there anything good here?

lines.zh: 我出生第一件事是找金子。
lines.en: The first thing I did after hatching was look for gold.
I shake off the shell and pick up a piece.
The fire keeps me nice and warm.

lines.zh: 我很小，但我知道自己要什么。
lines.en: I'm small, but I know what I want.
I take one lap of the ground first.

lines.zh: 这地方太光了，没有藏处。
lines.en: This place is too bare; nowhere to hide things.
I lift my nose out of the broken shell.
I claim this stone first.
I'll name myself.
It's bright out, and I'm not used to it.
My wings aren't stiff yet; I'll run for now.
I tumble out of the chest.
One of these is silver.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，然后看你的口袋。
lines.en: I look up at you, then at your pocket.
Let me sharpen my teeth.

lines.zh: 这个世界的金子好像不多。
lines.en: There doesn't seem to be much gold in this world.

lines.zh: 我的鳞被烤卷了，疼得直转。
lines.en: My scales curl in the heat and I spin in pain.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，屁股先着地。
lines.en: I land on my rump from a height.

lines.zh: 我扑腾着，爪子抓不到东西。
lines.en: I thrash, and my claws catch nothing.

lines.zh: 炸得我滚出老远，宝贝全散了。
lines.en: The blast rolls me far and scatters all my treasures.
An arrow pins me to the dirt.

lines.zh: 那股光让我鳞片全竖起来。
lines.en: That light makes every scale stand up.

lines.zh: 我饿得没力气数东西了。
lines.en: I'm too hungry to count anything.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我吓得钻到石头下。
lines.en: The flash sends me diving under a stone.

lines.zh: 我在空里转，找不到落脚的地方。
lines.en: I tumble in the void with nowhere to land.
